PERFOVERHAUL.Settings.limiterEnabled.Hin: Lower the canvas frame rate while nobody is interacting with it or the window is in the background. Full speed returns instantly on canvas input and for any canvas animation, including other players' token movement.
PERFOVERHAUL.Settings.idleFPS.Name: Idle Frame Rate
PERFOVERHAUL.Settings.idleFPS.Hint: Frame cap while the canvas is idle. Animated lights and weather keep animating, just less smoothly. Set it to your Maximum Framerate to disable idle throttling.
PERFOVERHAUL.Settings.idleDelay.Name: Idle After (Seconds)
PERFOVERHAUL.Settings.idleDelay.Hint: How long after the last canvas input (mouse over the map, wheel, or keyboard outside of text fields) the canvas counts as idle.
PERFOVERHAUL.Settings.backgroundFPS.Name: Background Frame Rate
PERFOVERHAUL.Settings.backgroundFPS.Hint: Frame cap while the Foundry window is unfocused or hidden. If you capture the canvas for streaming, raise this to your Maximum Framerate.
PERFOVERHAUL.Settings.smoothVideo.Name: Keep Video Smooth
PERFOVERHAUL.Settings.smoothVideo.Hint: While a video map or tile is playing, never throttle the canvas below 30 FPS.
PERFOVERHAUL.Settings.tokenBarCache.Name: Cache Token Resource Bars
PERFOVERHAUL.Settings.tokenBarCache.Hint: Skip redrawing a token's resource bars when nothing they show has changed. Core redraws them on most actor updates, including ones that have nothing to do with the bars.
PERFOVERHAUL.Settings.tokenEffectCache.H: Skip rebuilding a token's status effect icons when its effects, icons, and tints are unchanged. Core destroys and recreates every icon on each redraw.
PERFOVERHAUL.Settings.tokenUiBatching.Hi: Hold bar and effect redraws for tokens outside the visible area (or hidden from you) until they come into view, and merge overlapping effect redraws of the same token into one.
PERFOVERHAUL.Settings.chatBatchSize.Name: Chat Messages per Batch
PERFOVERHAUL.Settings.chatBatchSize.Hint: How many chat messages the chat log renders at a time, when the world loads and each time you scroll back. Fewer makes loading into the world faster.
PERFOVERHAUL.Settings.preloadScenes.Name: Preload Upcoming Scenes
PERFOVERHAUL.Settings.preloadScenes.Hint: Quietly load the textures of this many nearby navigation-bar scenes (the active scene first) during idle time, so switching to them skips the download. Set to 0 to disable.
PERFOVERHAUL.Settings.preloadVideos.Name: Preload Video Files
PERFOVERHAUL.Settings.preloadVideos.Hint: Include video maps and tiles when preloading. Videos are large and use a lot of memory, so this is off by default.
PERFOVERHAUL.Settings.hudEnabled.Name: Show Performance HUD
PERFOVERHAUL.Settings.hudEnabled.Hint: A small overlay with frame rate, CPU time per frame, limiter mode, main-thread stalls, memory, texture cache size, and canvas object counts. Toggle it with Ctrl+Shift+P; drag its title bar to move it.
PERFOVERHAUL.Optimizer.MenuHint: Check this client and scene for performance problems and apply a settings preset in one click.
PERFOVERHAUL.Optimizer.Title: Performance Optimizer
PERFOVERHAUL.Optimizer.PresetsHint: Presets change client settings for this browser only, then reload. Highlighted values are the ones a preset would change.
PERFOVERHAUL.Optimizer.Presets.quality.H: Foundry's normal settings for capable hardware, with gentle idle throttling.
Medium lighting quality and native-resolution rendering on high-DPI screens. Looks almost the same and is much lighter on laptops and 4K displays.
PERFOVERHAUL.Optimizer.Presets.performan: Low lighting quality, 30 FPS, no light or vision animation. For integrated graphics, old machines, and very busy scenes.
PERFOVERHAUL.Optimizer.NoChanges: These settings are already in use.
PERFOVERHAUL.Optimizer.ConfirmIntro: These settings will change for this browser:
PERFOVERHAUL.Optimizer.ConfirmReload: Foundry will reload to apply them.
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.SoftwareRendering.De: The canvas is being drawn by the CPU ({renderer}). Turn on hardware acceleration in your browser settings, or update your graphics drivers. Nothing else here will matter as much as this.
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.GPU.Title: Graphics: {renderer}
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.WebGL1.Title: WebGL 2 is unavailable
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.WebGL1.Detail: Foundry is running on WebGL 1, which is slower and less reliable. Update your browser and graphics drivers.
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.PixelRatio.Title: Rendering at {dpr}x resolution
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.PixelRatio.Detail: Your display scaling makes the canvas draw {dpr}x as many pixels in each direction. Turning off "Scale resolution with pixel ratio" (the Balanced and Performance presets do this) cuts roughly {saving}% of the GPU's pixel work, at the cost of slightly softer art.
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.MaxMode.Title: Performance Mode is Maximum
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.MaxMode.Detail: Maximum mode uses the most expensive lighting and rendering options. If the canvas feels sluggish, try the Balanced preset.
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.TextureMemory.Title: Texture cache: about {mb} MB
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.TextureMemory.Detail: Approximate memory held by Foundry's loaded textures on this client.
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.TextureTooLarge.Titl: This map is too large for your GPU
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.TextureTooLarge.Deta: The background is {w}x{h}px but your GPU supports at most {max}px. Resize the image or split it into tiles.
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.LargeMap.Title: Very large map image ({w}x{h}px)
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.LargeMap.Detail: This background alone uses about {mb} MB of video memory and takes longer to load for every player. Maps under 8192px on each side, saved as WebP, load much faster.
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.MapSize.Title: Map image is a reasonable size ({w}x{h}px)
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.MapFormat.Title: Map is saved as {ext}
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.MapFormat.Detail: Converting it to WebP usually makes the file several times smaller with no visible loss, so the scene loads faster for everyone.
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.AnimatedLights.Title: {count} of {total} lights are animated
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.AnimatedLights.Detai: Animated lights force a redraw every frame. The adaptive frame limiter keeps them cheap while the canvas is idle.
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.ManyWalls.Title: {count} walls on this scene
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.ManyWalls.Detail: Every vision and light update tests against every wall. Merging short wall segments into longer ones speeds up token movement and lighting changes.
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.ManyTokens.Title: {count} tokens on this scene
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.ManyTokens.Detail: Large token counts slow down vision updates. Delete or move unused tokens to another scene.
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.Videos.Title: {count} video map or tile on this scene
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.Videos.Detail: Video is uploaded to the GPU every frame it plays. With Keep Video Smooth on, the limiter still allows 30 FPS while it plays.
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.ChatLog.Title: {count} chat messages in this world
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.ChatLog.Detail: Every message is downloaded by every player at login. A GM can export the chat log and then clear it from the Chat tab to make the world load faster.
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.DragPreview.Title: Live token drag preview is on
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.DragPreview.Detail: Recomputing vision on every frame of a drag is costly on scenes with many walls. It is a world setting in Core Settings.
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.Modules.Title: {count} modules active
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.Modules.Detail: Use the Hook Profiler to measure what each module actually costs during play.
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.LimiterOff.Title: The adaptive frame limiter is off
PERFOVERHAUL.Health.LimiterOff.Detail: The canvas renders at full speed even when nothing is happening. Turn it on in this module's settings.
PERFOVERHAUL.Profiler.MenuHint: Measure how much time each module, the system, and core spend in hook handlers and window renders, to find what is slowing your game down.
PERFOVERHAUL.Profiler.Title: Hook Profiler
PERFOVERHAUL.Profiler.Unsupported: Performance Overhaul: hook profiling is not available on this Foundry version. See the browser console (F12) for details.
PERFOVERHAUL.Profiler.Copied: Profiler report copied to the clipboard.
PERFOVERHAUL.Profiler.CopyFailed: Could not reach the clipboard; the report was printed to the console (F12) instead.
PERFOVERHAUL.Profiler.Summary: {duration}s recorded. Hook handlers ran for {total} ms in total, {pct}% of that time.
PERFOVERHAUL.Profiler.RendersHint: Wall-clock time from the start to the end of each render, including waiting on data and templates.
PERFOVERHAUL.Profiler.GuessedHint: This handler was registered before Performance Overhaul loaded, so its package was inferred from its code.
PERFOVERHAUL.Profiler.EmptyTitle: Find out what is slowing your game down
PERFOVERHAUL.Profiler.EmptyStep2: Play normally for a minute or two: move tokens, open sheets, roll some dice, change scenes.
PERFOVERHAUL.Profiler.EmptyStep3: Press Stop and read the tables. Red rows had at least one call long enough to drop a frame.
PERFOVERHAUL.Profiler.EmptyNote: Times are the main-thread work done inside each hook handler, excluding nested handlers. Work a handler starts asynchronously is not counted. Profiling adds a little overhead of its own while it runs.
PERFOVERHAUL.Hud.Title: Performance
